description: This file defines internal classes and enums related to transaction recording and commit roles within the Orleans distributed transaction system. It includes the TransactionRecord class templated on a state type, as well as an internal enum CommitRole that describes participant roles during commit protocols.

classes.name: TransactionRecord`1
classes.description: Represents a per-transaction record at each participant, including state, role, participant info, and methods to determine readiness to commit.

methods.name: AddRead
methods.description: Increments the number of reads performed in this transaction.

methods.name: AddWrite
methods.description: Increments the number of writes performed in this transaction.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transaction record for debugging, formatted based on participant role.

classes.name: CommitRole
classes.description: Enumerates the roles a participant can play in a distributed transaction commit protocol.
